comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Cloud (9-knob): a dense, diffuse ambient reverb. HorizonL's half-rate tank with an allpass inside every line of the loop and five input diffusers, so the tail turns to fog instead of echoes.
fxid_comment: 0x01A7. Project reserved Delay block, next to Droplets (422).

params.name: Size
params.comment: params[5]. The space (the delay lines x0.4 .. x2.0); turning it bends the pitch of the tail.

params.name: Decay
params.comment: params[6]. Reverb time, about 1 s to a minute and a half; 100 holds the tail forever and stops taking new sound.

params.name: Diff
params.comment: params[8]. Smear: at 0 the echoes of the lines can still be heard, at 100 no attack is left.

params.name: Mod
params.comment: params[9]. Slow movement of the delay lines: chorus in the tail, detune at the top.

params.name: Tone
params.comment: params[10]. High cut inside the tail, 1.2 .. 10 kHz: dark to bright.

params.name: Lo
params.comment: params[11]. Low cut inside the tail, 20 .. 600 Hz.

params.name: Swell
params.comment: params[12]. Each note blooms into the reverb, over up to 2 s; 0 off.
